result.question: What were Nvidia's total assets at the end of its latest fiscal year?
result.answer: NVIDIA's total assets at the end of its latest fiscal year (fiscal year 2026, ending January 25, 2026) were $206,803,000,000 (approximately $206.8 billion), as reported in its 10-K filing [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:Assets:2026-01-25].
